sources.title: LocalLLM: Running Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on an RTX 4070 Ti
sources.snippet: The exact model I use is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive-IQ4_XS. IQ4_XS quants are decent enough for me, and quite fast. The model has 40 experts (I don't know how to get the info, but the internet said so), and I found that 24 experts the CPU would give me best results, in terms of VRAM usage and speed.
